title: 第23章 血髓丹突破第24章 炼气七层阴煞针
content_zh:
山脉，顾景元看着前方。
血玉蜂赤玉正在和一只一阶中品的青风蛇大战。
赤玉差不多炼气四层中期出头，那青风蛇也差不多。
进化后，赤玉速度极快，防御也强，性格也凶残很多，尾针带毒，但不算很厉害。
它还能吸食精血、吞噬血肉来修炼。
赤玉和青风蛇僵持百息，最终赤玉抓住一个机会，极速振翅，突袭而去，尾后针死死刺入青风蛇腹部。
青风蛇嘶吼不止，赤玉顶着青风蛇尾横扫，硬生生将口器刺入，开始吸食青风蛇的血肉。
随着吸食，青风蛇痛苦嘶鸣。
“血玉蜂，似乎是一个不得了的进化方向啊。”
顾景元看着，眼中诧异起来。
因为他发现，随着血玉蜂吸食青风蛇血肉，血玉蜂的气息居然在一点点增强。
这是不是意味着，后续只要有足够的血肉，便可快速提升？
“不，不对，血玉蜂虽然可以吸食，可也得有个消化过程，这才吸食三分之一，似乎就已经到达极限了。”
看着远处的血玉蜂异动，顾景元也反应过来。
“不过，这血肉被吸食了一部分，也没办法出售了，可以留着等其消化了，便可继续吸食。但其皮和蛇牙，毒囊什么的，都是好东西。”
说着，顾景元又眼中绽放光芒：“赤玉进化成功，接下来便要准备冲击炼气七层的事情了。手中还有一块血髓晶，看看能不能想办法请炼丹师炼制一颗血髓丹，壮大气血，祛毒伐髓，这样冲击炼气后期的机会也大一点。还有就是炼制法器，不过当务之急是换一个新的灵兽袋，下品的已经没办法容纳赤玉了。”
让赤玉在山脉隐藏，顾景元连忙往返了一次坊市，出售下品灵兽袋，又购买了新的中品灵兽袋。
然后将赤玉装入中品灵兽袋，这才再次返回坊市之中。
客栈中，顾景元盘点身上的东西。
“灵石不到两百块了，先去购买炼器材料，到时候出售法器，得了灵石之后再去丹阁问问炼制血髓丹的事情。”

休息一晚，次日出去，下午时分返回，身上的灵石花得只剩下三十块了。
“接下来便是炼器了，十份下品炼器材料，四份中品炼器材料，应该能炼制好几柄法器吧。”
房间中，烈焰升腾不止。
整整一个月时间，顾景元看着前面的六柄法器，脸上轻松不少。
四柄一阶下品法器：血石剑、血石盾、精铁剑、裂石刀；两件中品法器：红甲盾、毒蝎剑。
“红甲盾虽然比不上罡铁盾，可好歹也是一阶中品防御法器，卖个两百多灵石应该没问题。毒蝎剑品质上乘，以红甲晶蝎尾炼制，并用青风蛇毒囊、血玉蜂毒、碧蛇毒等几种剧毒淬炼，是件好法器。自己留着，但可以把裂金剑出售掉了。”
他带上法器，出去了一趟。
不多时，将四件下品法器，中品法器红甲盾，裂金剑全部出售，身上的灵石达到六百块。
“接下来去一趟丹阁，看看能不能谈妥。”
转头前往一个名声不错的丹阁，见到侍女之后便直接道明来意。
很快好几位炼丹师都有兴趣，但一听到只有一块血髓晶的时候，又都犹豫起来了。
一块血髓晶，那就只有一次机会。
一旦炼制失败，那就对自己的名声不太好了。
content_en:
Gu Jingyuan looked ahead at the mountains.
Blood Jade Bee Red Jade is fighting with a first-level mid-level Green Wind Snake.
Chiyu is almost in the middle of the fourth level of Qi refining, and the Green Wind Snake is almost there.
After evolving, Akadama is extremely fast, has strong defense, and has a much more ferocious personality. The tail needle is poisonous, but it is not very powerful.
It can also absorb blood essence and devour flesh and blood to cultivate.
Akadama and the Green Wind Snake were in a stalemate for hundreds of seconds. Finally, Akadama seized an opportunity, flapped his wings at high speed, and pounced away, stabbing the back needle of the Green Wind Snake into the belly of the Green Wind Snake.
The Green Wind Snake kept roaring, and Akademer swept across the Green Wind Snake's tail, thrust its mouthpart forcefully into it, and began to suck the Green Wind Snake's flesh and blood.
As it sucked, the Green Wind Snake screamed in pain.
"The Blood Jade Bee seems to be an incredible evolutionary direction."
Gu Jingyuan looked at it with surprise in his eyes.
Because he discovered that as the Blood Jade Bee sucked the blood and flesh of the Green Wind Snake, the aura of the Blood Jade Bee was actually getting stronger.
Does this mean that as long as you have enough flesh and blood, you can quickly improve?
"No, that's not right. Although the Blood Jade Bee can suck, it still needs a digestion process. It has only sucked a third of it, and it seems to have reached its limit."
Seeing the strange movement of the Blood Jade Bee in the distance, Gu Jingyuan also reacted.
"However, since part of this flesh and blood has been sucked, there is no way to sell it. You can keep it until it is digested, and then you can continue sucking it. But the skin, snake teeth, poison sacs, etc. are all good things."
As he said that, Gu Jingyuan's eyes shone with light again: "The red jade has evolved successfully, and now we are ready to attack the seventh level of Qi refining. I still have a blood marrow crystal in my hand. Let's see if we can find a way to ask an alchemist to refine a blood marrow pill to strengthen the Qi and blood, detoxify and cut down the marrow. This will have a greater chance of impacting the later stages of Qi refining. There is also the refining of magic weapons, but the top priority is to get a new spirit beast bag. The low-grade one can no longer accommodate the red jade."
Letting the red jade hide in the mountains, Gu Jingyuan quickly went back and forth to the market, selling low-grade spirit beast bags and buying new mid-grade spirit beast bags.
Then he put the red jade into the middle-grade spirit beast bag, and then returned to the city again.
In the inn, Gu Jingyuan took inventory of his belongings.
"The spirit stone is less than two hundred yuan. Let's buy the materials for refining the weapon first. When the time comes, we will sell the magic weapon. After we get the spirit stone, we can go to the Dan Pavilion to ask about refining the blood marrow pill."
After resting for one night, he went out the next day and returned in the afternoon. He only had thirty yuan of spiritual stones left.
"Next is the weapon refining. Ten low-grade weapon refining materials and four medium-grade weapon refining materials should be able to refine several magic weapons."
In the room, flames continued to rise.
For a whole month, Gu Jingyuan looked at the six magic weapons in front of him with a relaxed expression on his face.
Four first-level low-grade magical weapons: Bloodstone Sword, Bloodstone Shield, Fine Iron Sword, and Stone-Splitting Knife; two medium-grade magical weapons: Red Armor Shield and Poisonous Scorpion Sword.
"Although the Red Armor Shield is not as good as the Gang Iron Shield, it is still a first-level mid-level defensive magic weapon. It should be no problem to sell it for more than two hundred spirit stones. The Poison Scorpion Sword is of high quality. It is refined from the red armor crystal scorpion tail and tempered with several kinds of poisons such as Green Wind Snake Venom Sac, Blood Jade Bee Venom, and Jade Snake Venom. It is a good magic weapon. You can keep it for yourself, but you can sell the Gold Splitting Sword."
He took the magic weapon and went out.
Not long after, he sold all four low-grade magic weapons, the medium-grade magic weapon Red Armor Shield, and the Splitting Gold Sword, and the number of spiritual stones on his body reached 600 yuan.
"Next, I'll go to Dan Pavilion and see if we can reach an agreement."
He turned around and headed to a well-known Dan Pavilion. When he saw the maid, he directly explained his purpose.
Soon several alchemists were interested, but when they heard that there was only one blood marrow crystal, they all hesitated.
A piece of blood marrow crystal, then there is only one chance.
Once the refining fails, it will be bad for your reputation.
